frontmatter.description: Extract a reusable procedure from a completed artifact, session or solved problem, retaining evidence and testing transfer to a second case. TRIGGER: "turn this into a skill", "extract the method", "capture this workflow", "make what we did reusable". SKIP: a new skill with no completed artifact → skill-creator; organizing continuity notes → note-organizer; API or project documentation → technical-writing-craft; a one-document fact inventory → llms-txt- tooling (references/document-distiller.md).
